name: Edge Eloquent Source
subtitle: Official source repository for Edge Eloquent on-device dictation
description: The official Feather and AltStore-compatible repository for Edge Eloquent. Distributes standalone signed or sign-ready IPAs of Edge Eloquent, powered by Google AI Edge runtime for private on-device dictation.

apps.name: Edge Eloquent
apps.subtitle: Private on-device dictation powered by Google AI Edge
apps.localizedDescription: Private iOS dictation powered by the official Google AI Edge LiteRT-LM runtime and compatible audio models from Hugging Face. Model artifacts are downloaded on demand and verified with SHA-256. Optional cloud text enhancement and web search are disabled by default. Audio never leaves the device.
apps.versionDescription: Adds Hugging Face audio-model search, the approximately 1.85 GiB VibeVoice ASR BitNet model, and Qwen3-ASR 0.6B with Russian support for 4 GB iPhones. Only compatible .litertlm audio bundles can be imported.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for real-time speech-to-text dictation directly on your device.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds Hugging Face audio-model search, the approximately 1.85 GiB VibeVoice ASR BitNet model, and Qwen3-ASR 0.6B with Russian support for 4 GB iPhones. Only compatible .litertlm audio bundles can be imported.

Keeps the selected Gemma transcription engine active, surfaces the original LiteRT loading error instead of silently switching engines, and reports unavailable Apple on-device language support clearly.
Fixes on-device speech recognition: recording now starts before cold model loading, buffered audio is preserved, LiteRT uses validated file-backed WAV input, and iOS memory use is reduced.
Official LiteRT-LM 0.16.1 runtime, on-device Gemma 3n dictation, local cleaner, and optional Cloudflare text enhancer. Model weights are not bundled.
